title: UK Tender Deadline & Cancellation Changes
desc: For bid teams: compare official Find a Tender notice histories for your procurement watchlist. Get changed deadlines and statuses with old/new values and source links. Pay only for delivered changed-notice rows.

title: UK Government Tenders: Contracts Finder & Find a Tender
desc: Search new UK public-sector tenders and contract awards from Contracts Finder and Find a Tender in one run. Filter by keyword, CPV code, buyer, value, deadline and SME suitability. Official open OCDS APIs, Open Government Licence, personal contact details removed.

title: UK Tenders API: Contracts Finder & AusTender Awards
desc: UK and Australia government tenders and contract awards as JSON: Contracts Finder and AusTender (official OCDS data). Title, buyer, value, dates, CPV/UNSPSC, winning supplier. Filter by keyword, value, date; daily new-only feed. Tenders API, procurement data. $5 per 1,000.

title: Government Tenders & Procurement Tracker (EU, UK, Ukraine)
desc: Track public tenders across Europe — one tender per row with buyer, deadline, contract value, category codes and awarded supplier. Covers EU (all member states), UK Contracts Finder and Ukraine, in one common format. Public data, no account needed.

title: Public Tenders API: EU Tenders, Find a Tender, Contracts Finder
desc: Public tenders API: EU tenders, TED tenders (Tenders Electronic Daily) and UK tenders (Find a Tender, Contracts Finder). Government tenders, public procurement, UK government contracts and contract awards. Filter by CPV. Daily tender alerts. Not affiliated with TED or the EU.

title: UK Public Tender Lead Alert
desc: Watch UK Find a Tender for public-sector tenders newly matching your keywords, CPV codes, value threshold or region, and get only the new ones since your last check.
